description: Phone-screen validation set (Phase 5). Real, openly licensed photographs from Wikimedia Commons (originally Pixabay / Unsplash CC0 uploads). Screen quadrilaterals were annotated manually by the implementer on the 1280px-wide thumbnails; they are approximate (+/- 10-20 px) and are not third-party ground truth. Camera angles, screen brightness, hand occlusion and phone size vary, including two small, oblique phones in a candid street scene.

images.note: Close-up; display is cut off by the frame, so the mask cannot be fully measured.
Hand-held iPhone, display facing the camera; the bezel/chin below the display is the keep-clear region.
Small, oblique phones in a candid scene; hard case, display mostly dark.
Tilted phone with a bright, reflective display; bezel/chin below the display is the keep-clear region.
Hand-held Android phone with a bright app-grid display; thumb overlaps the screen edge.
